question: The length and breadth of a cuboid are 50 cm and 75 cm, respectively. If the length of the diagonal is 17sqrt29 cm, then what is the volume (in cm³) of the cuboid?​
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Diagonal **d² = l² + b² + h²**

(17√29)² = 50² + 75² + h²

289 × 29 = 2500 + 5625 + h² ⇒ 8381 = 8125 + h²

h² = 256 ⇒ **h = 16 cm**

Volume = 50 × 75 × 16 = 60000 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 60,000 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Length (l) = 50 cm, Breadth (b) = 75 cm, Diagonal (d) = 17√29 cm.

**Formula Used:** Diagonal of Cuboid = √(l² + b² + h²); Volume = l × b × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28c72eda1d008d663678bd06bd717f6d3bd3da04427605287cf6a50f8793f0f6.png] 

⇒ d² = l² + b² + h²

⇒ (17√29)² = 50² + 75² + h²

⇒ 289 × 29 = 2500 + 5625 + h²

⇒ 8381 = 8125 + h²

⇒ h² = 8381 − 8125 = 256

⇒ h = √256 = 16 cm

⇒ **Volume of cuboid** = l × b × h = 50 × 75 × 16

⇒ Volume = 3750 × 16 = 60,000 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 60,000 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cuboid

The total surface area (TSA) is given by the formula 2(lb + bh + hl).

Lateral Surface Area of Cuboid

The lateral surface area (area of four walls) is 2h(l + b).

Diagonal of a Cube

For a cube with side 'a', the diagonal is a√3 and the volume is a³.</p
